title: Affine criterion for local ideal annihilation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $J$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaf data [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], $F$ any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U$ an affine open and $s\in F(U)$. Then $a(s|_V)=0$ for every open $V\subseteq U$ and $a\in J(V)$ if and only if $as=0$ for every $a\in J(U)$.

source.place: Properties, Tag 01PO (lemma-sections-annihilated-by-ideal), proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PO

proof.text: For an affine W contained in U, J(W) is the extension of J(U) along restriction (IdealSheafData.map_ideal). The ideal of scalars killing s restricted to W contains every restricted section of J(U); by the ideal map/comap adjunction it contains J(W).

source.place: Properties, Tag 01PO (lemma-sections-annihilated-by-ideal), proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PO

proof.text: For any V contained in U, cover V by all affine W contained in V. Naturality of the ideal inclusion and its image formula show that a in J(V) restricts into J(W). Thus each restriction of a times s restricted to V is zero. Separatedness gives zero on V. Conversely apply local annihilation with V=U and identity restriction.

lean.statement:
theorem annihilator_affine_criterion (X : Scheme.{u}) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F : X.Modules) (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(F, U.1)) :
    (∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U.1), ∀ a ∈ J.idealOfOpens V,
      a • F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s = 0) ↔ ∀ a ∈ J.ideal U, a • s = 0
